testEnvironment:
Test environment: the snapshot is a git repository whose single commit holds
the reviewed tree — its tree hash was compared against the commit under review
when the snapshot was cut. A suite run here collects and runs what a checkout at
that commit does, so a failing or skipped test is a fact about the tree, not
about this copy of it. Its history is that one synthetic commit: 'git log',
'git diff' and every ancestry question answer about the snapshot and never about
the PR.
The Recipe's Test entrypoint and Check step do not run these merge-gating CI steps, and nothing in this review ran them: Verify branch is rebased on base (needs pull-request context and full git history, not the worktree); Validate renovate.json (fetches renovate from the npm registry via npx on every run); smoke-omp (needs bun and a globally installed pinned omp binary); install-and-smoke (needs bun and a globally installed pinned omp binary).

unverified.claim: The first new test's title says "the gate does not search it", but its gate assertion can't tell a gate-only widening apart from the original: the gate-only mutant (tallies over all units, judged set over the Fit's own units) leaves this test green. That's because growTree searches only judged Cells, and this Cell isn't judged.
unverified.evidence: Mutant M3 in correctness/copy: `const tallies = tally(all, order);` + `const drawn = tally(units, order).filter` → 3-file run exit 1, tests 255 pass 252 fail 3. The failing tests were 'a live classifier's undrawn Pulls in a judged Cell…', '…with no assignment probability…' and 'control: …'. The first test ('a Cell whose counted Pulls are all a live classifier's undrawn ones is not judged … and the gate does not search it') passed. The suite still kills the mutant, so this is only a title/intent mismatch, not a coverage hole.
unverified.suggested_fix: Optional: reword the title (e.g. 'and the gate's search is unchanged'), or rely on test 2 as the gate-search pin, which it already is.

unverified.claim: The ticket's 'judged-set only' mutation variant is killed by exactly one test, so that acceptance criterion depends on that one test alone.
unverified.evidence: Mutant M1 in correctness/copy: `const drawn = tally(all, order).filter` → exit 1, tests 255 pass 254 fail 1. Only 'a Cell whose counted Pulls are all a live classifier's undrawn ones is not judged…' failed, with judgedIn = [true,true,true,false]: cells and the cost/speed reasons gained slow-medium, estimates did not. For comparison: M2 (`const tallies = tally(all, order)`, judged set + gate) → fail 4, all four new tests. M4 (`const units = all`) → fail 5, the four new tests plus the existing 'fit: a non-exploration row a live B classifier routed is the A/B's test set, not fit input'. All acceptance-criterion mutants are red and the unmutated baseline is green (22/22 in split-fit; 9302/9302 in the controller's run).
unverified.suggested_fix: None required. A second judged-set assertion, e.g. in the control test, would add redundancy.

unverified.claim: The `live` helper only uses sizing 'haiku', so a filter that admits any non-'haiku' sizing_src (instead of only 'rule') survives.
unverified.evidence: red: n/a (survivor); mutant `sizing_src !== "haiku"` at ticket-router.mjs:807 -> ./agent-test tests/split-fit.test.mjs exit 0, 22 pass 0 fail; baseline: same cmd → exit 0, 22 pass
unverified.suggested_fix: Add a live Pull with another sizing value (e.g. 'sonnet' or 'sonnet-fallback') alongside 'haiku' in one test.

unverified.claim: The new docblock says a Pull with a `sizing` other than "rule" and no `draw` is 'one a live classifier routed', but the Fit's filter also drops a blank `sizing_src` that no live classifier produced, and the same wording is repeated in the split-fit.test.mjs `live` helper comment.
unverified.evidence: ticket-router.mjs L727-736: sizingSrc starts as "rule", is set to "" when readSizing returns null (the 'no-sizing' degrade), and otherwise takes the live classifier's src ('haiku' or 'jev:<model>'). fitPulls L807 keeps only `exploration_draw !== "" || sizing_src === "rule"`, so `sizing: ""` with no draw is excluded as well. The comment is accurate for "haiku" but not for the blank case.
unverified.suggested_fix: Word it as 'a Pull whose sizing_src is not "rule" (a live classifier, or blank when the sizing was missing) and with no draw is not the Fit's'.

unverified.claim: The '(the free classifier routed it)' gloss on the "rule" default is ambiguous. In ticket-router.mjs "rule" is the default sizing source, with no classifier involved, and the 'live classifier' is the other source (haiku or jev).
unverified.evidence: ticket-router.mjs L727 `let sizingSrc = "rule"`; it is overwritten only when the B arm is live and sizing was read (L730-736). The comment two lines later contrasts 'a live classifier' with the Fit's own Pulls, so a reader may take 'free classifier' as one more classifier kind.

unverified.claim: The comment '$1 a PR, cheaper than every starting Cell ... were it judged it would win the row' is a counterfactual that no assertion exercises: no test judges the live Cell and checks that it wins.
unverified.evidence: In diff lines 21-32 the 25 live Pulls are asserted absent from the table. The only run that judges slow-medium (the control test) uses a single drawn Pull with n=1, below MIN_N (20), so it never shows the win. I did not run this counterfactual.
unverified.suggested_fix: Soften the comment to 'would be a cheaper, MIN_N-clearing candidate', or add a control with 25 drawn Pulls that does win the row.
